resetDetail:
All website sessions, cookies, offline data and cache, plus the saved address, app permissions, custom name and icon, language, window state and app-managed notifications will be removed. This cannot be undone. The app will restart with a blank settings page.

Notification history may need to be cleared manually. Notification, camera and microphone permissions granted by the system are managed in system settings and will not be reset.
